panels.description: Alex pulls away the dust sheet, revealing Bi11bot: rugged weathered industrial blue and chipped mustard yellow, broad shoulders, dark optical eyes, rust-red scarf and angular chest armor marked clearly with a white Bi11 designation. Dust falls through warm workshop light. Leave upper-left clear.
Alex presses his palm to Bi11bot’s chest and feels for vibration. The robot remains dormant except for a mechanical response beginning under his hand. Keep the hand and white Bi11 mark visible.
Alex buckles Adrian’s watch onto his left wrist. The display window glows amber as the clasp closes. Leave upper-left clear for the sound effect.

The watch’s amber pulse answers through Bi11bot. His two optical eyes ignite warm amber, dust lifts and his rust-red scarf shifts. Alex steps back. Keep Bi11bot’s open face at eye level, both eyes visible and never looming or menacing.
Bi11bot stretches stiff mechanical arms as dust falls; the right-eye ring clicks and rotates. Alex remains out of focus behind him. Leave upper-left clear.
